system.permissions.camera.purpose.text: The app uses your camera to take the photos you send to your groups.
system.permissions.camera.purpose.pattern: platform.purposeString — one brief, complete sentence; active voice; sentence case; ends with a period; names the specific feature (HIG examples: 'The app records during the night to detect snoring sounds.'; App Review examples: 'The app uses location data to determine the recommended route to your destination and provide turn-by-turn directions.')
system.permissions.camera.purpose.notes: Subject 'The app' follows Apple's own examples (the alert already shows the app name above the string). Localize per App Review FAQ.

system.permissions.microphone.purpose.text: The app uses your microphone to record voice notes and the sound in videos you send to your groups.
system.permissions.microphone.purpose.pattern: platform.purposeString — one brief, complete sentence; active voice; sentence case; ends with a period; names the specific feature (HIG examples: 'The app records during the night to detect snoring sounds.'; App Review examples: 'The app uses location data to determine the recommended route to your destination and provide turn-by-turn directions.')
system.permissions.microphone.purpose.notes: Request only when the person starts a voice note or video: guideline 5.1.1(iv) forbids requiring microphone access before photo posting.

system.permissions.photosAdd.purpose.text: The app saves photos from your groups to your library when you tap Save.
system.permissions.photosAdd.purpose.pattern: platform.purposeString — one brief, complete sentence; active voice; sentence case; ends with a period; names the specific feature (HIG examples: 'The app records during the night to detect snoring sounds.'; App Review examples: 'The app uses location data to determine the recommended route to your destination and provide turn-by-turn directions.')
system.permissions.photosAdd.purpose.notes: Add-only access. 'Save' must match the photo.viewer save button label (owner/copy research).

system.permissions.photosRead.purpose.text: The app shows the photos you select so you can send them to your groups.
system.permissions.photosRead.purpose.pattern: platform.purposeString — one brief, complete sentence; active voice; sentence case; ends with a period; names the specific feature (HIG examples: 'The app records during the night to detect snoring sounds.'; App Review examples: 'The app uses location data to determine the recommended route to your destination and provide turn-by-turn directions.')
system.permissions.photosRead.purpose.notes: Only needed if the app reads the library with PhotoKit. Picking with PHPickerViewController/PhotosPicker needs no permission and no string (recommended).

system.permissions.contacts.purpose.text: The app uses the contacts you choose to invite people to your groups.
system.permissions.contacts.purpose.pattern: platform.purposeString — one brief, complete sentence; active voice; sentence case; ends with a period; names the specific feature (HIG examples: 'The app records during the night to detect snoring sounds.'; App Review examples: 'The app uses location data to determine the recommended route to your destination and provide turn-by-turn directions.')
system.permissions.contacts.purpose.notes: If contacts are uploaded/matched to find existing members, the string must say so explicitly (5.1.1(ii) 'clearly and completely describe'). Guideline 5.1.2(v): no 'Select All', show the invite message before sending.

system.permissions.preAlert.continue.notes: HIG: the single button on a pre-alert screen should use 'a term like Continue or Next'; never 'Allow'. iOS pre-alert screens get no Cancel/Skip.

common.alert.cancel.notes: HIG: 'Always use the title Cancel for a button that cancels an alert's action.' Used by every confirmation alert/action sheet (settings.account, safety.block, safety.report).

common.alert.ok.notes: Informational alerts only; HIG: avoid OK as the default title unless the alert is purely informational. M3: avoid vague 'Done, OK, or Close' for confirming actions.

settings.account.delete.confirmButton.notes: HIG example of a specific button title ('Erase,' 'Convert,' 'Clear,' or 'Delete'). Destructive role. Same verb on Android as the confirming dialog action.

settings.account.delete.title.pattern: platform.alertTitle — HIG: a complete-sentence title uses sentence case and ending punctuation; one or two lines max; M3: 'brief, clear statement or question'; avoid 'Are you sure?', 'Warning!', apologies
settings.account.delete.title.notes: Wording is new; Yope-voice research may adapt it within this pattern.

settings.account.delete.message.text: This deletes your account and everything you shared with your groups, including photos, voice notes and messages.
settings.account.delete.message.pattern: platform.alertMessage — HIG: informative text only if it adds value; complete sentences, sentence case, punctuation
settings.account.delete.message.notes: Content is required: Apple's 5.1.1(v) FAQ says user-generated content shared with others must be deleted with the account. Conflicts with tenet 'Nothing gets lost' — owner decision (see PLATFORM_CONSTRAINTS.md §9).

settings.account.delete.subscriptionNote.text: Your subscription keeps renewing until you cancel it in your subscription settings.
settings.account.delete.subscriptionNote.notes: Required disclosure: 'Billing for an auto-renewable subscription continues through Apple until people cancel'. No store trademark per CONVENTIONS §4. Pair with showManageSubscriptions / Play Subscription Center link.

safety.block.confirmButton.pattern: platform.alertButton — HIG: one- or two-word verb describing the result, title-style capitalization, no punctuation (examples 'View All', 'Reply', 'Ignore', 'Erase', 'Delete')
safety.block.confirmButton.notes: Destructive role on iOS; confirming action on Android. Yope-voice research may not change the verb without breaking the pattern.

safety.report.confirmButton.pattern: platform.alertButton — HIG: one- or two-word verb describing the result, title-style capitalization, no punctuation (examples 'View All', 'Reply', 'Ignore', 'Erase', 'Delete')

paywall.restore.pattern: platform.alertButton (title-style capitalization of HIG phrase 'restore purchases')
paywall.restore.notes: Required element: 'A way for existing subscribers to sign in or restore purchases'. Adapted only by title-casing the HIG phrase.

paywall.privacyPolicy.notes: Link required on the sign-up screen and in settings (5.1.1(i)).

paywall.terms.evidence: https://developer.apple.com/app-store/subscriptions/ ('links to your Terms of Use and Privacy Policy')
paywall.terms.notes: HIG uses 'Terms of Service' for the same link; pick one name to match the actual legal document title (owner).

widget.home.small.description.text: See the newest photo from your group.
widget.home.small.description.pattern: platform.widgetDescription — HIG: begin with an action verb; no 'This widget shows…'/'Add this widget'; sentence-style capitalization; one description for all sizes (HIG examples: 'See the current weather conditions and forecast for a location', 'Keep track of your upcoming events and meetings.')
widget.home.small.description.notes: Shared by all home-screen sizes (HIG: single description) and reused as android:description (Android Tier 1: unique succinct description). Locket copy research may supply a reference-voice variant within the pattern.
